---
applyTo: "**/*.tsx,**/*.ts"
---

# Internationalization (i18n)

All user-facing text must be localized. No inline string literals in UI.

## Rules

- Every user-visible string must use an i18next translation key via `useTranslation` / `t()`.
- Do not hardcode labels, placeholders, error messages, button text, or headings as inline strings.
- When adding a new translation key:
  - Add the key and English value to the relevant `en.json` locale file.
  - Add the key and Arabic value to the relevant `ar.json` locale file (use a placeholder if translation is pending, never omit the key).
- Shared/common keys → `packages/shared/src/i18n/locales/`
- App-specific keys → `apps/<app-name>/src/i18n/locales/`
- Use existing key namespaces and naming conventions before adding a new namespace.
- Run `corepack pnpm parse-locales` after adding keys to regenerate locale indexes if the project uses i18next-parser.
